lines.en: Treacherous swine! Your army is annihilated! Surrender yourself, and Veridia's forces will leave Sayunaa in peace.
lines.zh: 背信弃义的猪猡！你的军队已经全灭了！现在投降，维尔迪亚的军队就会离开萨育纳。

lines.en: A thousand generations of curses upon you, Veridian scum. Mark my words, there will be a day when you bend the knee to us.
lines.zh: 我诅咒你千代血脉，维尔迪亚人渣。等着瞧吧，总有一天你们会向我们卑躬屈膝。

lines.en: Final warning, Duke Rostam! Surrender, and return to your capital, or I will put you down myself!
lines.zh: 这是最后的警告，罗斯坦公爵！现在投降你还能回自己的都城，否则我会将你手刃！

lines.en:
You have indeed taken much from me...
But at what cost?!

lines.zh: 啊！！ 那就作为一名懦夫死去吧！！
